title: Nvidia and SK hynix sign long-term AI memory supply partnership

sources.quote: As a follow-up measure to solidify their previous long-term technical partnership, this agreement allows NVIDIA to secure a stable supply of next-generation AI memory, while enabling SK hynix to expand the foundation for growth.
Advancing Next-Generation AI Memory SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.

explain: Nvidia signed a long-term deal to secure SK hynix's next-generation AI memory, including HBM, for its chips. It is part of a wider SK–Nvidia plan the companies say is worth more than $500 billion, but no dollar figure was given for the memory part alone, so none is shown here.
